announcements.title: MINOR - CSE Notification PESU Electronic City Campus (August December 2026 )
announcements.body:
Dear Student,
Greetings of the day!
The Department of CSE is pleased to inform you to register for the minor courses offered during the Aug-Dec 2026 session at EC Campus.
Students of 3rd ,5th and 7th Semester from NON CSE & AIML branches (ECE) can register for minors in CSE.
IMPORTANT NOTE:
1. Any minor course subject will be offered by the department only if the strength of interested students is greater than or equal to 30
2. A student can opt for a maximum of one minor course during this session.
-Note: DSA is prerequisite for DAA
3. Last date of registration for minor course: 7th August 2026.
Link for Registration -
Click here to register
4. Commencement of the courses: 10th August 2026.
5. Please find the attachments below for your reference
a. Minor Course syllabus.
b. Calendar of Events of Minor Courses.
c. Minor Course notification.
Students need to register with a valid email id as all further communication about the course will be through the registered email id.
Please mail your queries if any to deeptic@pes.edu or contact in person at BE Block, Third Floor Staffroom.No 317
Payment of Fees to be done on or before 21st August 2026 (Online mode through PESU App).
Regards,
Department of Computer Science Engineering
PES University - Electronics City Campus

.  Please note the details given below.
1. Eligibility: 3rd/5th/7th semester Engineering students of PES University

announcements.title: End Semester Examination Schedule – July 2026
announcements.body: The End Semester Examinations for all UG and PG programs will commence from July 28, 2026. Students are requested to download their hall tickets from the student portal. Seating arrangements will be displayed on the notice boards of respective departments.

announcements.title: PES University Placement Drive – Microsoft
announcements.body: Microsoft will be conducting an on-campus recruitment drive on August 5, 2026 for B.Tech CSE, ECE, and MCA students. Eligible students must register on the placement portal by July 30. Pre-placement talk will be held on August 4 at 2:00 PM in Seminar Hall 1.

announcements.title: Library Extended Hours During Exam Period
announcements.body: The Central Library will remain open from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM during the examination period (July 28 – August 15). Students are encouraged to utilize the reading rooms and digital resources available.

announcements.title: Workshop on AI and Machine Learning – Registration Open
announcements.body: The Department of Computer Science is organizing a 3-day workshop on 'Practical Applications of AI and Machine Learning' from August 10-12, 2026. Industry experts from Google and Amazon will conduct hands-on sessions. Registration is free for PES students.

announcements.title: Hostel Fee Payment Deadline – August 2026
announcements.body: Students residing in university hostels are reminded that the hostel fee for the next semester must be paid by August 1, 2026. Late payments will attract a penalty of ₹500 per day. Payment can be made through the student portal.

announcements.title: Inter-University Sports Meet 2026
announcements.body: PES University is hosting the Inter-University Sports Meet from August 20-25. Events include cricket, football, basketball, athletics, and swimming. Interested students can register with the Sports Department by August 10.

announcements.title: New Bus Routes Added – Whitefield & Electronic City
announcements.body: Two new bus routes have been added for the upcoming semester: Route 15 (Whitefield via ITPL) and Route 16 (Electronic City via Silk Board). Students can register for these routes through the transport portal starting August 1.

announcements.title: Research Paper Submission Deadline – ICSE Conference
announcements.body: Faculty and PhD scholars are informed that the deadline for submitting research papers to the International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027) has been extended to September 15, 2026. Contact the Research Office for formatting guidelines.

announcements.title: CAD Design Challenge 2026 – Intercollegiate 8-Hour CAD Design Hackathon
announcements.body:
CAD Design Challenge 2026 – Intercollegiate 8-Hour CAD Design Hackathon
The Department of Mechanical Engineering, PES University, Bengaluru, in association with
Mighty Machines
– Technical and Industry Partner, invites students to participate in the
CAD Design Challenge 2026
, an intercollegiate 8-hour CAD design hackathon.
Event Date: 14 November 2026
Venue: B605C, Engineering Design Studio, Department of Mechanical Engineering, PES University, Bengaluru
Duration: 8 Hours
Registration Fee: ₹1,500 per team
CAD Software: SOLIDWORKS
Last Date for Registration: 10 November 2026
About the Event
CAD Design Challenge 2026 provides a platform for students to demonstrate their CAD modelling, engineering design, creativity, and problem-solving skills by working on an
industry-oriented problem statement provided by Mighty Machines
.
The hackathon will focus on hands-on design activities using SOLIDWORKS software, covering the following key stages of mechanical design: Part Modelling, Assembly Modelling, Engineering Drafting.  Participants will have the opportunity to collaborate with peers, apply their technical knowledge to real-world engineering challenges, interact with industry professionals, and compete for exciting prizes. Internship opportunities, with potential full-time employment (FTE) prospects, may also be explored for deserving participants.
Registration and Payment Instructions
PES University students:
Registration fee payment must be made exclusively through PESU Academy.
External college students:
Please complete the registration questionnaire and pay the registration fee using the QR code provided in the form.
Further details regarding the event rules, schedule, problem statement, and submission requirements will be communicated to registered teams.
Register now and showcase your engineering design skills at CAD Design Challenge 2026!

announcements.title: CyberClash 2.0 Hackathon - ISFCR(SOC)
announcements.body:
Dear Student,
CyberClash 2.0 is here! Are you ready to Attack. Defend. Survive Doomsday ?
The ISFCR Security Operations Center (SOC) presents CyberClash 2.0, a Cyberthon where your team has to attack and defend at the same time.
After CyberClash 2026 (30+ teams, 8 hours of live-fire action), we’re back bigger: a 12-hour live Attack-Defense CTF on home grown infrastructure.
What to expect
Red Team: attack every other team’s environment, capture flags, and race to exploit.
Blue Team: defend your own Windows domain controller and Linux web app, using a real detection and monitoring stack.
Every team defends and attacks at once, in an all-against-all battlefield with tick-based scoring and live injects.
Key details
Team size: 4 members (2 Red + 2 Blue)
Entry fee: ₹200 per team
Prize pool: ₹1,00,000+ (cash prizes for 1st, 2nd, 3rd, Best Red Team, Best Blue Team, and more), plus certificates for all participants
Important dates
Registration: Nov 15, 2026 - Jan 10, 2027
Round 1 (Qualifier, Jeopardy-style CTF, online): Jan 23, 2027
Round 2 (Grand Finale, Attack-Defense CTF, on-site): Jan 30, 2027
Venue: 13th Floor, BE Block, PES University
Top 45 teams from the qualifier advance to the finale.
No prior Attack-Defense experience needed. Bring your teammates and your curiosity, and we’ll provide the infrastructure.

workers.dev/

announcements.title: Service Alert: Global Microsoft 365 Outage & Service Disruptions
announcements.body:
Dear Students,
Please be aware that a major global technical outage is currently impacting Microsoft's cloud infrastructure across 74 countries and territories, which may affect your access to campus digital services.
Affected Services:
• Microsoft Outlook & Exchange Online (email delivery and inbox access)
• Microsoft Teams (messaging, calls, and meetings)
• Microsoft Copilot
• OneDrive & SharePoint Online
• No IT Ticket Needed: Our IT team is actively monitoring the situation, so you do not need to submit a support ticket regarding these services.
• Email & Work Continuity: Outgoing and incoming emails may be delayed while systems stabilize. Please use alternative communication channels for urgent coordination until full service is restored.
We will provide a follow-up update as soon as Microsoft confirms full resolution. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Regards,
IT Team
PES University
